## 2026-10-27T17:05:00Z - Source-foundation Phase 4 workflow path

- Task: add an explicit foundation renderer to the production generation
  workflow without changing the creative path.
- Workflow inputs: `renderer` (`creative` or `foundation`), `foundation_id`, and
  `foundation_policy` (`renderable-only`, `allow-partial`, or
  `allow-adaptation`). Repository dispatch can supply the same fields.
- `renderer_policy` resolves and validates the renderer before the generation
  job. The foundation renderer requires a foundation ID and the full profile.
  Unknown renderers and unknown policies fail closed. `allow-adaptation` fails
  closed with a clear message until the agent adaptation stage exists.
- Creative authoring, candidate evidence, rendered repair, diagnostic preview,
  and one-shot repair registration are guarded by
  `renderer == 'creative'`. The foundation path selects the source foundation,
  copies it into the client repository, writes
  `design.experience = { renderer: "foundation", ... }`, and records
  `foundation_select`.
- The shared preview step branches internally. The foundation branch asserts
  `data-foundation-dossier`, `data-experience-pack`, the contact section, the
  shared lead form, the license credit, and the absence of creative or legacy
  markers. It runs `verify-rendered-revision.mjs` and the SEO release gate
  before deploying the preview.
- Stage events now include `foundation_select`, `foundation_render`, and the
  existing preview stages. The failure step records
  `failure-stage=foundation_render` and
  `failure-category=foundation_render` for foundation failures.
- The visual manifest has a foundation branch with the required sections
  `hero`, `conversion`, `services`, `faq`, and `contact`, and optional
  `coverage` and `social-proof`.
- Runtime CSS is now scoped to the shared `xp-foundation-shell` class so the
  generic foundation renderer and the `season-wheel` pack use the same ribbon,
  service, contact, footer, and form treatment. The generic Spicer demo passed

- Validation: 66 focused workflow, tracking, pack, promotion, and renderer
